dedupe_keys.name: workforce management information office of rail and road

description: Workforce Management Information - Office of Rail and Road is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Rail and Road. Monthly management information on staff numbers and pay bill costs in the Office of Rail and Road. For workforce numbers, both payroll and non-payroll (contingent labour, including consultants) information is provided, split between full-time equivalents (FTE) and headcount, with payroll staff numbers mapped to standard Civil Service grades. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Rail and Road. It offers 76 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2021-08-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
